experiment: Same-person, same-physical-80 dual encoder on sub-04. 200 unique official images, one per object. Old 65/200 retrieval for each encoder with 28 distinct wins per encoder was known before this test.

third_party.training: The authors' reconstruction code uses a 1024-dimensional EEG vector, regression to OpenCLIP ViT-H/14 image features together with contrastive image loss (training alpha 0.90). preprocessing selects laion2b_s32b_b79k. Official test EEG is averaged over repetitions before encoding; our training approximation averages four released single-presentation feature rows per photograph in published order.
third_party.limit: The original authors evaluate all official test labels/images each epoch and report a best epoch; the released feature archives do not prove which checkpoint produced them. Do not claim a fully blind official benchmark. ATM has upstream access to the generic calibration and validation objects; only our downstream ridge excludes them, so this is development evidence. The authors' reconstruction example inserts a learned diffusion prior before rendering. Native unit coordinates and angular distribution require an empirical check before direct reuse.

split: 884 generic objects fit / original 64 generic objects angle calibration / separate 64 generic objects gate. All are drawn from the earlier frozen 1012; reserve official labels and images until all test vectors and 1854 scores are hashed.
transform: Mean four released trial features in float64, then unit normalize. Try directly released unit ATM first: direct must have median angle to physical train-image center within 0.15 rad of real images and aligned cos advantage over a fixed cross-object shift of 170 photos above 0.02 on calibration 64 only. Otherwise standardize unit-ATM coordinates from fit rows (floor SD 1e-6), regress centered unit real H14 via isotropic ridge penalty 1.0 per sample; add the training target mean. Calibrate its single global median angular gain on 64 classes, clipped [0.25,8], with the original calibrated real 95th-percentile angular cap. Refit on 1012 with all other settings fixed and reuse the gain and cap. Ours is the earlier unmodified global named R80 companion. Dual is unit(0.5*unit(ours)+0.5*unit(ATM)); wrong rolls the dual and the frozen ours word by 67, retaining recipient image seed.
gate: On held 64 classes (640 physical R4 training photos), the ATM condition must have aligned mean native cosine at least 0.02 above the cyclic cross-object foil and within-object pairwise win above half. The equal-weight dual must have positive mean matched-vs-cross-object cosine margin, at least that of ours, and within-class pairwise win at least that of ours. No tuning or substitute if gate fails. Overlap of ATM upstream training makes these diagnostics optimistic.
separate_words: Original selected joint32 1854-word score vs released ATM direct text head vs fixed equal-weight per-row z-standardized fusion. This path never affects image prompts. Report all three full1854 and 200-gallery results only after freezing test predictions. New-word prompting is not part of these packets.
unit: 80 measurements per query; no doubled observation count.
